ownershipRules.rule: Can manage product pages, variants, product media, pricing, inventory, orders, pages, and storefront settings for the same business_id.
Can manage only products, orders, fulfillment, or content permissions explicitly assigned by the store owner.
Can view and manage only carts, orders, addresses, saved items, and profile records linked to the same user_id.
Can manage platform-level settings, tenant support, billing status, domain status, and escalated support actions.

checkoutControls.transactionBoundary: Create one store order, order_items, inventory reservations, payment provider reference, and audit trail atomically.
checkoutControls.inventoryRule: Inventory deductions occur only after payment authorization or confirmed order status. Adjustments require audit logged stock movement entries.

aiControls.fallbackBehavior: If AI output fails validation, keep the last valid product schema and ask the user for one clarifying detail.

rules: Every store-owned record must include business_id.
Every owner/staff mutation must include actor_user_id and role.
Public storefront reads can only expose active and published records.
Customer records can only be read by the linked customer, store owner/staff with explicit permission, or platform admin support.
